title: Field Application Engineer (Fresher)
description: Lead on-site commissioning, hardware integration, and technical support for Dicot Innovations' Industrial IoT and SCADA systems (Vision S, Vision C, and Vision Web). You will work directly at manufacturing facilities to configure PLCs, sensors, and industrial communication protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, RS-485), troubleshoot edge deployments, and ensure seamless plant-floor operations.
